name: A Gift for the Great Fairy
Xenoblade Chronicles 2
hint: À noite, procure as estrelas vermelhas na Ponte de Hylia, no olho esquerdo de Skull Lake e no topo de Hebra Peak.
At night, watch for red shooting stars at the Bridge of Hylia, the left eye of Skull Lake, and the summit of Hebra Peak.

name: Snowball Bowling
detail: Roll the snowball down the slope and aim to knock down all ten pins.

name: Boom Bam Golf
detail: Strike the boulder across Tanagar Canyon and aim for the hole in as few hits as possible.

name: Mounted Obstacle Course
detail: Take a horse to the course and clear the hurdles in order.

name: Mounted Archery
detail: Stay on horseback and shoot the balloons before the timer runs out.

name: Sand-Seal Racing
detail: After freeing Vah Naboris, complete the course through the marked gates.

name: Flight Range
detail: Use the updraft and shoot the targets while gliding.

name: Treasure Chest Game
detail: Talk to Cloyne and choose one of the three chests.

name: Bird-Man Research Study
detail: Glide from the tower and land as far from the departure point as possible.

name: Gut Check Challenge
detail: Climb the rock and collect the required rupees before you reach the top.

name: Lord of the Mountain
hint: Quando a luz verde aparecer, vá até o lago sob a cerejeira. Aproxime-se em silêncio se quiser montar.
When the green light appears, head to the pond beneath the cherry tree. Approach quietly if you want to mount.

name: Hylian Shield
hint: No cárcere do castelo, derrote o Stalnox para abrir o baú do escudo.
Defeat the Stalnox in Hyrule Castle’s Lockup to reveal the shield chest.

name: The Horned Statue
hint: Fale com a estátua na encosta perto da entrada da vila para trocar um recipiente de coração por vigor, ou vice-versa.
Talk to the statue on the slope near the village entrance to trade a heart container for stamina, or the reverse.

name: Eventide Island
hint: Ao chegar à ilha, você perde o equipamento temporariamente. Use o que encontrar e leve as três esferas aos altares.
You temporarily lose your equipment on arrival. Use what you find and carry the three orbs to their pedestals.

name: Kilton
hint: Procure Kilton à noite no lado oeste do lago. Depois de falar com ele, a loja passa a aparecer perto de vilas à noite.
Look for Kilton at night on the western side of the lake. Once you talk to him, his shop appears near villages at night.

name: Horse God Malanya
hint: Abra a fonte para poder recuperar cavalos registrados que morreram.
Open the fountain to revive registered horses that have died.
